decision.rationale: Promoted. The fused baseline dispatched only one serial worker per tile and took 776.67-777.35 ms for RGB8 512x512 batch 8. Parallel MCU sampling/FDCT/quantization followed by ordered per-tile entropy preserves exact codestream hashes and improves that workload to 395.85-396.52 ms (-49.06% to -48.96%, p=0). Batch 1 at 512 improves 61.59-61.74%, and a 64x64 single tile improves 61.58-62.13%. A subprocess-isolated fallback/candidate matrix produced the same aggregate SHA-256 b9af03a1a522926f3bee386fd554f146db773cf8287cef91d9001335c88c3a26 for Gray and RGB 4:4:4/4:2:2/4:2:0 across quality 1/90/100, restart absent/present, and odd padded edges. After the decision, the measurement-only environment switch and legacy fused kernels were removed; the promoted path retains checked coefficient allocation, the exact regression matrix, and an isolated 100-line shader unit.
